# RELEASE


## DETAILS


## Uniti Group Inc. to Participate at Upcoming Conferences


September 15, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.uniti.com/node/16766/pdf)


LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Uniti Group Inc. (“Uniti”) (Nasdaq: UNIT) announced today that senior leaders of Uniti are scheduled to participate at the following upcoming conferences:


**Deutsche Bank 34** **th** **Annual Leveraged Finance Conference:** Paul Bullington, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer, and Drew Smith, EVP, Strategic Finance, are scheduled to host investor meetings on September 29, 2026 in Scottsdale, AZ.


**RBC Capital Markets 2026 Global Communications Infrastructure Conference:** Greg Ortyl, President of Strategic Accounts, and Bill DiTullio, SVP, Investor Relations & Treasury, are scheduled to host investor meetings on September 30, 2026 in Chicago, IL.


**ABOUT UNITI**


Uniti (Nasdaq: UNIT) is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. We build, operate, and deliver fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy. Our broad portfolio of services is offered through a suite of brands: Uniti Wholesale, Kinetic, Uniti Fiber, and Uniti Solutions. Visit us online at[www.uniti.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Nb5Q3aOvVA2BhnS5pcOXK5j2VbRF06FBSuuIwJNrjW61hF7yNmeF_3YyeEh99Jv4F72LN6heliAjhfi1FeiZEA==) .
